title: Sad Girl Summer - Pride edition
description:
Portland's biggest bummer of a drag show is back for our third year and sadder than ever!

Kick off Portland Pride weekend with cozy community to witness a star-studded cast of queer artists bring their saddest acts to the stage.

Sad Girl Summer is about celebrating the melancholy that comes with our brightest days - all facets of sadness (heartbreak, anger, silly-sad) are welcome here!

So bring your tissues, layer on your favorite waterproof mascara, and join us in soaking up the sadness that comes with the rising heat of summer.

Co-hosted by Sugarpill and RESIDENT SAD GIRL Carmen!

Design by Zepheur (theodrake.com)

Sad Girl Summer 2026 is funded in part by the Regional Arts & Culture Council and the Office of Arts & Culture.

title: STANK x YES COACH: PRIDE WEEKEND
description:
For one sweaty night only, San Francisco’s legendary STANK and Portland’s favorite athletic slutty playground are joining forces for a celebration of sweat, scent, gear, competition, and unapologetic Pride weekend debauchery.

🍻 PREGAME // 8PM-10PM

Come early.

Grab a drink.

Meet some new teammates.

Run a few try-outs.

Win some prizes.

Check out the field before the real games begin.

TIX: https://members.pdxsanctuary.com/events/93071
🔥 MAIN EVENT // 10PM-4AM

Then things get a little sweatier.

Expect athletes, gear pigs, pit worshippers, jocks, wrestlers, pups, leatherfolk, dancers, and every flavor of Pride weekend trouble under one roof.

We’ll have competitions, giveaways, live performances, music, eye candy, and enough musk in the air to make your Uber driver ask questions tomorrow morning.

No judgment.

No attitudes.

No benchwarmers.

Whether you’re here to compete, flirt, dance, show off your favorite gear, chase a trophy, bury your face in a championship-caliber pit, or simply follow your nose wherever it leads, there’s room on the team.

🎧 JUMPR (SF), Bro Hoe & Lake Everett
💦 Hosted by Spencer Adam & Tucker Max
🌙 Open until 4AM

Suit up.

Get sweaty.

Play hard.

And if you lose?

Well, that sucks.

There’s probably a pig around here who’s more than happy to explain where you went wrong.

 TICKETS
TIER 1 – Early Stank VERY LIMITED: $26 BAG CHECK INCLUDED. EARLY DOGS GET THE BONE — THESE WILL GO FAST.
TIER 2 – Funkmaster (AFTER 1 SELLS OUT): $35
STILL A DEAL. BUT YOU WAITED… AND YOU MIGHT REGRET IT.
DOOR (IF AVAILABLE): $45
VERY LIMITED. FIRST COME, FIRST SERVED. NO PROMISES.
TIX: https://members.pdxsanctuary.com/events/93071
And we stay open until 4AM. So hurry back over to top or bottom off your night when everyone else shuts down.
We heard you loud and clear after last year. The music was AMAZING. The energy matters. The vibe matters. So the favorites are back behind the decks and we’re dialing the entire night up harder.
Dress athletic.
Dress cocky.
Dress like you’re about to win something.
Bring the good musk. Not the “forgot deodorant three days ago” kind. The freshly worked-out, locker room, competitive filth kind.
Champions Smells get VIP.
TIX: https://members.pdxsanctuary.com/events/93071

title: Pride Parade: March with Sanctuary
description:
Sanctuary is happy to march in Pride Parade again. Join us. Wear what you feel and let yourself shine.
This is FREE and FUN!!
This event is for all of those without another group to march with. If you feel it in your heart, join us on the streets.


Last year we were number 123 (after being last or almost last in previous years). Please check the sanctuary website (www.pdxsanctuary.com) which we will update when we finally get the marching number. 
That said… its a parade. Expect the butterfly effect. For every group that marches on time, each dawdler will delay.
MOBILITY NOTE: : I have done the march on a mobility scooter due to injury. We roll slightly downhill, so that part is easy. However, you may have to go a few blocks south at the end of the march to get into an Uber zone. Scootering all the way back to Sanctuary uphill was not fun!
Marching is a sublime experience. With all the anti-gay and anti-trans bullshit happening around the country, it is more important than ever to show that no one can silence our voices.
 
Sanctuary is in the center of the staging area so we just wait until its our turn to roll.
FAQ
Q: Is this all-ages? Yes! But we cannot have underage people inside Sanctuary per the OLCC.
Q: What is the cost? Free!
Q: What if I identify as (blank), can I still come? Yes! The Pride Parade is about showing support for all gender expressions and identities. We believe it is important to show the forces of darkness and tyranny that every day, there are more of us than there are of them
